verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's 'computer' ecosystem gives the assistant a real execution surface. It can run Python in the browser or via Open Terminal, browse and edit files, and run a test suite on a schedule. A coding agent works in real workspaces and worktrees, with every file read and edit shown as a tool card behind Allow / Deny approvals. Plugins also execute arbitrary Python on the server. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of arbitrary shell-command execution on the user's own local machine (versus a server or workspace), and independent hands-on corroboration of the terminal and file-edit features beyond a passing community mention of code execution.
